item.title: Trump’s AI Task Force to Commission Report on Technology’s Risks
item.description:
## **Takeaways** by Bloomberg AI [Subscribe](https://www.bloomberg.com/subscriptions) President Donald Trump’s artificial intelligence task force in its first meeting agreed on Thursday to address risks related to cybersecurity, biosecurity and “model control and accountability” as fears rise over the potential dangers posed by the technology.
The panel known as the Super Intelligence Force — using the president’s preferred term for artificial intelligence — will commission a report from the President’s Council of Advisers on Science and Technology to evaluate those and other concerns, according to a White House account of the meeting.

item.title: Summit explores promise & perils of AI
item.description:
# Summit explores promise & perils of AI The promise and perils of rapidly advancing artificial intelligence — a technology reshaping how we think, learn, work, and live — took center stage at UC Riverside's first AI Summit on October 15.
[Gaurav Sukhatme](https://viterbi.usc.edu/directory/faculty/Sukhatme/Gaurav), interim dean of USC's Viterbi School of Engineering and director of the USC Stevens School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence, argued that AI is challenging fundamental assumptions about human intelligence and achievement.
